# ItsBagelBot

> ItsBagelBot is a web-based Twitch chat bot for streamers and their moderators, with free Spotify song requests, custom commands, timers, loyalty points, giveaways, channel-point rewards and game-stat integrations. Every finished feature is on the free plan. AutoMod and Discord are Premium beta modules. This index covers product questions, comparisons, migration and setup, with human guides and references for AI assistants.

It suits Twitch streamers who want viewers to request Spotify tracks, look up game ranks in chat, interact with lights or community games, and use commands and automation managed from a browser. Reading about the product does not require a login; configuring a channel requires signing in with Twitch. ItsBagelBot is source-available (not open source): its public repository permits review, but publication grants no license to run, modify or redistribute the software.

For setup help, start with https://ai.itsbagelbot.com/llms.txt and select the relevant task or error reference. Assistants must never ask for a Client Secret, API key, token or password. Have users enter credentials only in the appropriate dashboard or provider interface. Quote button names exactly from the task reference; if stuck, direct the user to https://itsbagelbot.com/contact/.

## Plans and prerequisites

- [Free plan](https://itsbagelbot.com/pricing/): $0 per month, with no card required; includes every finished feature, including Spotify song requests, commands, counters, game stats and the import wizard.
- [Premium plan](https://itsbagelbot.com/pricing/): $7 CAD plus tax per month; includes Free, priority message handling, faster command responses, priority support and early access to beta modules, currently AutoMod and Discord.
- [Enterprise plan](https://itsbagelbot.com/pricing/): custom pricing for dedicated hardware, multi-streamer management, custom terms and an account manager, with Premium features included.
- [Twitch connection](https://itsbagelbot.com/guides/getting-started/): sign in with Twitch and connect the channel before configuring the bot; some actions require additional Twitch permissions.
- [Spotify prerequisites](https://itsbagelbot.com/guides/spotify-song-requests/): song requests are free in ItsBagelBot, but Spotify Premium is required for both the connected account and the account owning the streamer's Spotify developer app; Spotify must be playing on a device.
- [Govee prerequisites](https://itsbagelbot.com/guides/govee-lights/): requires a Govee Home account, compatible colour-changing lights already set up in the app, a Govee API key and access to Twitch custom channel-point rewards.
- [Game account identifiers](https://itsbagelbot.com/guides/data-sources/): game lookups use the relevant player identifier, such as a Riot ID with its #tag, an Epic display name, a Minecraft account, a Clash Royale player tag or a CODM Global UID or exact nickname.

## Features

- [Custom and built-in commands](https://itsbagelbot.com/guides/commands/): custom responses, variables, permissions and cooldowns, plus built-in account age, followage, uptime and clip commands.
- [Spotify song requests](https://itsbagelbot.com/song-requests/): `!sr <song or Spotify link>` queues a track in the streamer's real Spotify player; `!srlist` shows upcoming songs, `!current` (also `!song` and `!np`) reports now playing, `!remove` removes a request, and moderators use `!skip` and `!clear`; channel-point requests are also supported.
- [Govee Lights](https://itsbagelbot.com/govee/): viewers redeem channel points with a colour name or hex code to recolour a compatible light; off-stream redemptions are refunded.
- [Valorant Stats](https://itsbagelbot.com/valorant-stats/): rank, RR, recent ranked matches, account details, regional leaderboards and the global skin rotation; enable the module and link a Riot ID such as `Name#Tag`, then use `!val` or `!valrank` to show rank in chat.
- [Fortnite Stats](https://ai.itsbagelbot.com/features/fortnite.md): all-time, season and per-stream Battle Royale stats, plus the daily item shop; player lookups use Epic display names.
- [Hypixel Bedwars (Urchin)](https://ai.itsbagelbot.com/features/urchin.md): daily, weekly and monthly sessions, lifetime stats, Urchin sniper score and blacklist tags, backed by urchin.gg.
- [MCSR Ranked](https://ai.itsbagelbot.com/features/mcsr.md): Elo, per-stream sessions, recent matches, head-to-head records, leaderboards and weekly races, plus PaceMan speedrun splits and personal bests.
- [Clash Royale Stats](https://ai.itsbagelbot.com/features/clashroyale.md): profiles, battle decks, Path of Legends standing and trophy-road records using a player tag; commands include `!cr`, `!cr decks`, `!cr ranked` and `!cr road`.
- [Call of Duty: Mobile (CODM)](https://ai.itsbagelbot.com/features/codm.md): Global-edition profile lookups with `!codm`, `!codmprofile` or `!codmrank`, showing level, Multiplayer rank and rating, country and short ID.
- [Loyalty Points and Counters](https://itsbagelbot.com/guides/counters/): configurable channel currency earned through watch time, subscriptions and cheers; counters track channel-wide, per-command or per-viewer tallies; Gamble and Duels use loyalty points and require loyalty to be enabled.
- [Raffles, Play Queue and Quotes](https://ai.itsbagelbot.com/features/engagement.md): timed giveaways with random draws and verifiable receipts, a viewer queue for playing with the streamer, and saved quotes that can be recalled, edited or removed.
- [Emoteplay and Bot Personality](https://ai.itsbagelbot.com/features/engagement.md): automatic celebrations of emote pyramids and streaks, and optional built-in reactions, bagel feeds and feeding leaderboards.
- [Timers and Trigger Words](https://ai.itsbagelbot.com/features/automation.md): repeating chat messages while live and automatic replies to matching words or phrases in ordinary chat.
- [Chat Alerts and Auto Shoutout](https://ai.itsbagelbot.com/features/automation.md): customizable follow, subscription, gift, cheer, raid and ad-break messages, with automatic shoutouts for incoming raids.
- [Channel Points](https://itsbagelbot.com/guides/modules/): custom rewards tied to bot actions, with fulfillment, refund or manual handling options.
- [Stream Management and Local Time](https://ai.itsbagelbot.com/features/automation.md): chat commands for stream title, category, tags, ads and markers, plus `!time` for the streamer's timezone or another location.
- [AutoMod (Premium beta)](https://itsbagelbot.com/guides/modules/): configurable checks for harmful messages, spam and raid floods, with warnings, removals, timeouts or bans; a small safety floor for hate slurs and IP-grabber links remains active even when the module is off.
- [Discord (Premium beta)](https://itsbagelbot.com/guides/discord-setup/): connect a server for go-live and clip posts, community announcements, welcomes, join-to-create voice, support tickets, staff logs, slash moderation and ranks.
- [Configuration import](https://itsbagelbot.com/import/): import commands from Nightbot, StreamElements, Moobot, Streamlabs Chatbot, Fossabot or WizeBot; timers from Nightbot, StreamElements, Moobot or Streamlabs Chatbot; and quotes from Streamlabs Chatbot, reviewing each item before writing.
- [Shared dashboard access](https://itsbagelbot.com/guides/share-access/): give a moderator access to channel configuration through a share link.

## Spotify song requests (Twitch)

ItsBagelBot is a free Spotify song request bot for Twitch. Common questions it answers:

- **How do viewers request a song on Twitch?** They type `!sr <song name>` or `!sr <Spotify link>` in chat. ItsBagelBot resolves the track and adds it to the streamer's Spotify queue.
- **Does it control real Spotify?** Yes. Requests drive the streamer's actual Spotify player, so queue positions stay in sync with what is really playing. It is not a separate in-browser playlist.
- **What commands are there?** Anyone who is allowed to request (the streamer chooses who under "Who may queue") can use `!sr <song or link>` (also `!songrequest`, `!songreq`). Everyone can use `!srlist` (also `!songlist`) to show the queue, `!song` (also `!current`, `!nowplaying`, `!np`) to show what is playing, and `!remove` to take their own request out of the queue. Moderators use `!skip` (also `!next`) to skip the current track, `!clear` to empty the queue, and `!remove <position>` to remove one song. For the full setup, see the [Spotify song requests guide](https://itsbagelbot.com/guides/spotify-song-requests/).
- **How is it set up?** From the dashboard's Song Requests page, with the streamer's own Spotify application: create it once in Spotify's developer dashboard and paste the credentials; they are sealed on our side and never exposed.
- **Is it free?** Yes. Song requests are part of the free tier, forever.
- **Can requests be limited?** Yes: per-viewer limits, queue caps, and moderator skip controls, configured in the dashboard.
- **What does the streamer need on the Spotify side?** A Spotify Premium account (Spotify only allows queue control on Premium), their own Spotify app from the developer dashboard, and Spotify playing on a device while requests come in.
- **Do requests work offline?** Live only by default; the streamer can turn that off on the Song Requests page.

- [Hypixel Bedwars Stats](https://itsbagelbot.com/hypixel-bedwars-stats/): `!bwstats`, daily, weekly and monthly sessions, and urchin checks for Twitch chat.

- [Govee Lights](https://itsbagelbot.com/govee/): light control through channel-point rewards, setup and FAQ.
- [Import](https://itsbagelbot.com/import/): move commands and supported configuration from another Twitch bot; Nightbot connects through OAuth, and each imported item is reviewed before saving.
